batch.description: Jahangirnagar University A Unit (গাণিতিক ও পদার্থ বিষয়ক অনুষদ — Faculty of Mathematical & Physical Sciences), academic session 2017-2018, printed SET CODE: 9 — full 80-question paper transcribed by direct visual reading of the solved-paper compilation PDF distributed via AdmissionWar/Google Drive (file ju-a-2017-2018-set2.pdf; the Drive listing labels this file 'Set-2' but the paper's own printed header reads SET CODE: 9, and the printed header governs). The compilation prints each question with options A-D, a Bangla explanation (ব্যাখ্যা) or 'Solve:' box and a boxed 'Ans: X' key; three questions (38, 42, 68) print 'Ans: Nill', the compilation's no-correct-option disposition, and three questions (5, 53, 54) print no key at all. EXTRACTION STAGE: all questions are content-UNVERIFIED and all keyed answers answer-UNVERIFIED — the printed publisher keys are preserved as-is and are NOT official university keys (JU publishes no official past papers). Transcription preserves printed wording, option order and errors; explanations are not transcribed. [UNVERIFIED import-format edition: only the questions that did NOT pass cross-source verification, with true statuses preserved; see Admission-Unverified-Import/README.md.]

sourceDocuments.title: JU A Unit admission test 2017-2018, SET CODE: 9 — solved-paper compilation (AdmissionWar / Google Drive PDF)
sourceDocuments.notes: Scanned solved-paper compilation, 10 pp., CamScanner scans carrying AdmissionWar watermarks (diagonal 'ADMISSION WAR' overlays and the red 'Download More Question Bank From www.admissionwar.com' banner) — the watermarks are the distributor's overlay, not part of the original paper. Paper header (PDF p.1) confirmed visually before transcription: A-ইউনিট, গাণিতিক ও পদার্থ বিষয়ক অনুষদ, জাহাঙ্গীরনগর বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়, ১ম বর্ষ স্নাতক (সম্মান) ভর্তি পরীক্ষা ২০১৭-২০১৮, পূর্ণমানঃ ৮০, সময়ঃ ৫৫ মিনিট, SET CODE: 9. A handwritten blue-ink circled '2' beside the header is a candidate's mark, not print, and was ignored. No publisher imprint is visible in the scan. Transcription by direct visual reading of 300-dpi page renders; a handful of boxed keys are partly covered by the watermark and are flagged in the per-question notes.
